label: D1 after a1 -> S1 (common) unrewarded, rarely firing
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), always with reward input 0, and always when the previous trial was a1 with a common transition to S1. All misses (17% of mass) are at the window first trial where the previous trial is outside the window; adding prev_action == -1 gives dev recall 1.0. So the feature is a necessary-condition detector for an a1-common-unrewarded outcome, and it uses only observed variables. However it fires on only about 9% of such steps (dev precision 0.09, F1 0.16). Firing is more likely after a run of unrewarded a1 trials: requiring the trial before also be a1-unrewarded gives precision 0.26, recall 0.61. It is also more likely mid-episode (trials 20-80, never before trial 10 or after about 85), when value is moderate (7.1-7.5), and when the D1 policy logit favours a1 moderately (choice 2.8-8). Coverage is flat across activation quartiles, so these conditions do not clearly modulate magnitude. It never fires after a reward, after a2, or after rare transitions. Next-trial switching is enriched (4.7x lift for next_stay == 0), consistent with a loss signal for the a1/S1 option, but it is not required.
